note: Chapter 17 (book pp. 526-597, PDF pp. 529-600) has 400 geometry questions. Extremely repetitive within each sub-pattern (polygon-angle algebra, cyclic-quadrilateral/trapezium facts, rhombus angle/diagonal, triangle classification, special segments of right and equilateral triangles, the incentre/circumcentre/orthocentre family, the basic-proportionality/angle-bisector cevian family, and circle theorems: tangent length, tangent-chord angle, chord-chord angle, chords of concentric circles, parallel chords). 32 representative questions were kept (2-4 per sub-pattern) and routed to three topic files: polygons (8, extending the existing topic), and two brand-new topics, triangles (16) and circles (8), since no topic file previously covered triangle centres or circle theorems. Unlike Chapter 16, this chapter has no compact answer-key table: the book gives full worked 'Explanatory Notes' instead, and the ones located cover only roughly the chapter's last 90 questions (about Q317-400), not the earlier questions this selection draws from. So every answer here was verified the primary way only: independently recomputed from the question's own numbers (never the book's working) and checked to match exactly one of the four printed options, with no separate book-key cross-check for this chapter.
